claims.claim_ar: نداء وتخاطب مباشر بـ«يا أهل الكتاب» لافتًا الانتباه وإدخال مخاطَبٍ خاص على سياق الخطاب، وهو نوع من الانعطاف الخطابي (التفات/التخاطب).
claims.claim_en: A direct vocative address 'O People of the Book' that attracts attention and inserts a specific addressee into the discourse — a stylistic shift/attention-grabbing turn (iltifat/vocative shift).

warnings: Only commentary chunks from al-Kashshaf (Zamakhshari) were provided. The requested sources (al-Jurjani, al-Sakkaki, al-Baqillani, al-Suyuti, tafsir balagha) are not present, so extra corroborating claims from those authors could not be extracted.

Extraction limited to rhetorical items clearly attested in the supplied chunks. Other plausible devices in the verse (e.g., contrast/antithesis between blocking the way and being 'witnesses') may exist in other sources but were not explicitly quoted in the provided chunks and thus were not asserted here.
